chunks: 4375 - The Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم passed by some women, stopped by them, then said:

"O assembly of women, I have not seen those deficient in intellect and religion more capable of taking away the minds of people of understanding than you. Indeed, I have seen that you are the majority of the people of the Fire on the Day of Resurrection, so seek nearness to Allah, Mighty and Majestic, as much as you are able."

Then one woman among them said, "O Messenger of Allah, what is the deficiency in our religion and our intellect?" He said, "As for the deficiency in your religion, it is the menstruation that affects you, so one of you remains, as Allah wills, not performing salat (prayer) and not fasting. And as for the deficiency in your intellect, it is your testimony: the testimony of a woman is only half the testimony of a man."

key_terms.دِينٍ: religious practice, here referring to acts such as salat and sawm
key_terms.شَهَادَةُ: testimony given in a legal setting
key_terms.عُقُولٍ: intellects or reasoning capacity, here mentioned in relation to testimony
key_terms.نَوَاقِصَ: deficient ones; those described as having a shortcoming in the stated sense

ai.seo_question: What does this hadith say about the meaning of deficiency in religion and intellect for women?
ai.summary: This hadith records an address of the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم to a group of women, warning them about the Hereafter and urging them to draw near to Allah. It then explains the intended meaning of deficiency in religion as the suspension of salat and sawm during menstruation, and deficiency in intellect in relation to legal testimony.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.4375 - The Messenger of Allah (swt) (peace be upon him and his family) passed by a group of women, stopped, and said:

"O assembly of women! I have not seen those who are deficient in intellect and religion more capable of taking away the reasoning of men of understanding than you. Indeed, I have observed that you will form the majority of the inhabitants of Hell on the Day of Judgment. So, seek closeness to Allah (swt), the Almighty and Glorious, as much as you can."

One of the women asked: "O Messenger of Allah (swt), what is the deficiency in our religion and intellect?"
He (sw) replied: "As for the deficiency in your religion, it is due to the menstruation that afflicts you, during which one of you may remain for a period, as Allah (swt) wills, without praying or fasting. And as for the deficiency in your intellect, it is because the testimony of a woman is equivalent to half the testimony of a man."
